paper.title: Strong yet ductile low-density steel via multiphase heterogeneous microstructure
paper.paper_scope: Developed a novel low-density Fe-0.25C-3Mn-2Al-0.4Si steel with a multiphase heterogeneous microstructure via intercritical annealing and low bainite aging, and investigated its strength-ductility balance and stress-concentration-mitigation mechanisms using experimental characterization and a phase mechanical response constitutive model.

alloys.description: A novel low-density steel designed for lightweight structural applications; it eliminates costly alloying elements Nb, Mo and Ni while slightly increasing Al and Mn content, and develops a multi-level multiphase microstructure through mechanical-metallurgical processing.
alloys.alloys_notes: S and P are trace impurities (0.009 wt% each). The steel eliminates costly alloying elements Nb, Mo, and Ni while slightly increasing Al and Mn content (b0015, b0148).

source.reason: The paper studies a single low-density steel composition, reported in b0018 as 'Fe-0.25C-3Mn-2Al-0.4Si-0.009S-0.009P'; all heat-treatment states derive from this same composition.

processes.description: 39 kg vacuum-induction-melted ingot hot forged into billets (90×70×40 mm), heated to 1200 °C and held for 60 min, hot rolled in six passes with 90% cumulative reduction (starting at ~1100 °C, finish rolling at 880 °C), then air cooled to 4 mm-thick plates.

source.reason: Hot-rolled state (HR) produced from billets heated to 1200 °C/60 min and hot rolled with 90% reduction; finish rolling at 880 °C followed by air cooling; labeled HR in Fig. 2/Fig. 3.

processes.description: Hot-rolled plate cold rolled on a four-roll reversible mill with 60% reduction to 1.6 mm thickness.

source.reason: Cold-rolled state produced by 60% cold reduction of the hot-rolled plate to 1.6 mm; labeled 'Cold rolling' in Fig. 2(b).

unmapped_findings: Critical transformation temperatures of the experimental steel: Ac1=705 °C, Ac3=950 °C, Bf=380 °C, Ms=346 °C (b0149).

Mechanical properties of aged samples: AN750-T (yield 697 MPa, tensile 1068 MPa, elongation 34.0%, PSE 36.3 GPa%); AN800-T (yield 985 MPa, tensile 1295 MPa, elongation 18.7%); AN850-T (yield 991 MPa, tensile 1269 MPa, elongation 13.9%) (b0044, b0046).
Retained austenite contents after aging: AN750-T 7.4%, AN800-T 2.4%, AN850-T 0.6% (b0036).
